paite: Huan Solomon in Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh toh kizolhna abawl hi. Pharaoh tanu akitenpih a, ama inn ding leh TOUPA' inn ding alam khit ma leh Jerusalem kulh a-umsuak masiah David khopi ah a omsak hi.
heading: Pilna Ngen In Solomon Athum / (2 Kro 1.3-12)

paite: Mipite kia mun sangte ah akithoih ua, huai ma in TOUPA min a dia inn akilam nai takdih louh ziak in.
Solomon in TOUPA a-it a, apa David dan thusehte azui a; mun sangte a kithoih in, gimlimte kia ana hal hi.
Kithoih ding in Gibeon ah kumpipa ahoh hi; huai lah mun sang poimohtak ahi ngal a. Solomon in huai maitam tung ah halmang thillat sangkhat alan hi.
Gibeon ah zan in Solomon kiang ah amang in TOUPA ahong kihil hi. Pathian in akiang ah, "Ngen in, bang ahia ka hon piak ding?" achi hi.

Solomon in, "Na sikha, ka pa David na mitmuh a thutak leh diktatna leh lungtang diktak pu a a-om bang in, nang akiang ah hehpihna thupi mahmah na langsak hi. Nang hiai hehpihna thupi mahmah ama a ding in na guan a, nang alaltutphah a tu ding tapa na pia a, tuni a ahong om petmah bang in.
Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, nang na sikha, ka pa David sik in kumpipa in na hon bawlta hi. Kei zaw naupang leltak ka hi a; thu tung lam leh pawt lam leng ka thei kei hi.
Na sikha, na mitelte, mi tampi, atam ziak ua sim seng vual louh leh azah theihseng vuallouhte lak ah a-om hi.
Huaiziak in na mite vai hawmsak ding in na sikha theihsiamna lungtang pia in, huchi a asia leh apha ka khenkak theihna ding in. Na mi hiai zah zouzai kua'n ahia vai hawmsak thei ding?" achi hi.
Solomon in huai ngen a, athugen in TOUPA akipaksak hi.
Pathian in akiang ah, "Na damsawtna ding, nang a dia hauhsaknate, na melmate sihna ding ngen lou a, vaihawm siamna dia theihsiamna na nget zawk ziak in;

ngai in, na nget bang in ka hihta hi. Ngai in, pilna leh theihsiamna lungtang ka hon pia hi. Huchi in na ma ah nang bang kuamah a-om kei ding ua, na nung in leng nang bang kuamah ahong om sam kei ding.
Na nget louh, hauhsakna leh zahtakhuaina leng ka hon pe lai hi. Huchi in na damsung in kumpipate lak ah nang bang a-om kei ding uh.
Na pa David in azuih bang a ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte zui dia ka lampite a na paileh ka hon damsawtsak lai ding hi,” achi hi.

Solomon akhanglou lou a, ngai in, mang ana hi. Huchi in Jerusalem ah ahoh a, TOUPA thukhun bawm ma ah adingh a, halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alan a, asikhate tengteng a ding in ankuang alui hi.
Kizuak numei nih kumpipa kiang ah ahong ua, ama ah ava dingh uhi.
heading: Solomon In Thubuai Haksa Akhen

paite: Numei khat in, "Aw ka toupa, hiai numei toh inn khat a tengkhawm ka hi ua; huai inn a amah toh ka om lai un nau ka nei hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ka nau neih nung ani thum ni in hiai numei in leng nau anei sam hi. Omkhawm ka hi ua; huai inn a om koute gel lou, kuamah mikhual om a-om kei hi.
Zan in hiai numei ta ana si a; ama'n adelhlup khak ahi.
Zan lai in athou a, na sikhanu a-ihmut kal in, ka sik a ka tapa ana la a, apom a, ama ta si pen ka ang ah ana sial hi.
Zingsang a ka ta nawi pe dia ka thohleh, ngai in, ana si khin hi. Himahleh zingsang a ka etchetleh ngai in, ka suan ka tapa pen ana hi kei," achi hi.

Numei dang in, "Hilou e. Ahing pen kei tapa ahi a, asi pen nang tapa ahi," achi hi. Khat in, "Hilou, asi pen na tapa ahi a, ahing pen ka tapa ahi,” achi tinten hi. Huchibang in kumpipa ma ah agen tuaktuak uhi.
Kumpipa'n, "Khat in, ahing pen ka tapa ahi a, asi pen na tapa ahi,” achi hi. Khat pen in, "Hilou, asi pen na tapa ahi, ahing pen ka tapa ahi zaw, achi zel hi," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n, "Namsau hon va lak un," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa ma ah namsau ahon tawi uhi.
Kumpipa'n, "Naungek hing pen tum nih suah unla, akimkhat khat pia unla, adang khat kiang ah akimkhat pia un," achi hi.

Naungek hing pen nu in ata alainat mahmah ziak in kumpipa kiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, naungek hing pen amah pe mai in, that mahmah ke'n," achita hi. Khat pen in, "Kei a hi tuan dah henla, nang a leng lah hi tuan kei heh. Himahleh tumtan hi hen," achita hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n adawng a, "Naungek hing pen that kei unla, amah pia un. Amah anu ahi,” achi hi.
Israel tengteng in huai thu a kumpipa thukhendan ana za ua; kumpipa alau uh. Vaihawm ding in Pathian pilna amah ah a-om chih athei uhi.
